commands.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- httpx/_decoders.py httpx/_models.py docs/api.md docs/async.md docs/quickstart.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "<evaluation>/eval-env/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"docs/async.md\")
content = path.read_bytes()
assert content.endswith(b\".\\n\")
path.write_bytes(content[:-1])
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "<evaluation>/eval-env/bin/python - <<'PY'
import ast
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

paths = (
    \"httpx/_decoders.py\",
    \"httpx/_models.py\",
    \"tests/test_decoders.py\",
    \"tests/models/test_responses.py\",
)
for filename in paths:
    ast.parse(Path(filename).read_text(), filename=filename, feature_version=(3, 9))
diff = subprocess.run(
    [\"git\", \"diff\", \"--unified=0\", \"--\", *paths],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout
long_lines = [
    line[1:]
    for line in diff.splitlines()
    if line.startswith(\"+\") and not line.startswith(\"+++\") and len(line[1:]) > 88
]
assert not long_lines, long_lines
print(\"Changed Python files parse as Python 3.9; added lines fit 88 columns.\")
PY"
